clue.text: Beauty treatment of French origin (Calais, possibly)

definitions.note: singular in the clue, while the entry is a plural noun: the clue loosely treats a course of them as one treatment

indicators.note: the origin of a word is where it starts, so only its opening letter is wanted
possibly signals that the bracketed town's letters, plus one more, could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A spa treatment claimed to come from France, perhaps from the port of Calais.
explanation.definitionFit: Facials are cosmetic skin treatments given at a salon, a standard kind of beauty therapy.

clue.text: Pedant from start to finish on position by compilers

indicators.note: start asks for the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the setters speaking of themselves: us
a spot is a place or position

explanation.surface: A stickler working from beginning to end on a place chosen by the setters.
explanation.definitionFit: A fussy, nitpicking person who frets over small details is a close match for a pedant.

clue.text: Eccentric kind of rough hustle

indicators.note: rough means crude or roughly made, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A strange, crude sort of swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: A hustle is a swindle, and this is the classic scam that wins a victim's trust before cheating them.

clue.text: Fall for an item of linen hotel included

indicators.note: the hotel letter is included within the linen item

parts.note: a valance is a short drapery round a bed frame
H is Hotel in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: Taking a tumble over a piece of hotel bed linen.
explanation.definitionFit: An avalanche is a fall of snow and ice down a mountainside.

clue.text: Australian half-rewritten scripture

indicators.note: rewritten means set down differently, so the letters are rearranged
half asks for the first five letters of the ten-letter word

explanation.surface: A holy text from Down Under, partly revised.
explanation.definitionFit: A sutra is a Hindu or Buddhist sacred text or aphorism, hence scripture.

clue.text: Let everyone outstanding be audibly spoken

parts.note: everyone means all
an outstanding debt is one still owed

explanation.surface: An instruction to let every remarkable thing be said out loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be audibly spoken' adds a further hint: the whole entry is pronounced like 'aloud'.
explanation.definitionFit: Let and this word are both past forms meaning permitted, as in 'he was let in'.

clue.text: An EU precursor lavishes love stories

parts.note: EC is the European Community, forerunner of the European Union
to dote is to lavish affection

explanation.surface: The forerunner of the European Union is fond of romantic tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Anecdotes are short, entertaining stories about real incidents.

clue.text: Somewhat emotionally upset, it's plain

indicators.note: upset in a down entry means turned upside down, read bottom to top
somewhat means some of, so part of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A little emotionally distressed, that's clear.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a grassy plain in Spanish America, especially Venezuela.

clue.text: Paced like men of York?

parts.note: the nursery rhyme's Grand Old Duke of York marched his ten thousand men to the top of the hill and back

explanation.definitionFit: The rhyme ends with the men neither at the top nor the bottom, after being marched to and fro on the hill.

clue.text: Upsetting oath about vessel in unenlightened time

indicators.note: about means around, so the reversed oath goes round the vessel
upsetting in a down entry turns the word upside down

parts.note: egad is a mild old-fashioned oath
Noah's ark is a vessel

explanation.surface: A shocking curse aboard a ship in a benighted era.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'Upsetting' stands the old oath on its head, giving DAGE, and 'about' has it wrapped round the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark age is a period of supposed ignorance and cultural decline, an unenlightened era.

clue.text: Virtue good … then to relish a version of the Arabian Nights

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase standing for a character from those tales, the famous seafarer

parts.note: saying virtue is good amounts to saying its opposite, sin, is bad

indicators.note: a version is a reworking, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A moral claim, then an invitation to enjoy a retelling of the old Eastern tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Virtue good' is restated by its opposite: sin is bad. 'version' rearranges TO RELISH A into the second and third words.
explanation.definitionFit: The seafaring hero of seven voyages is one of the best-known characters from the Thousand and One Nights collection.

clue.text: A pair of mice cavorting? Not love at first sight!

indicators.note: mice cavorting are leaping about, so the letters are jumbled
Not here says one item is to be left out of the letters

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Two mice frolicking, but this is no instant romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin legal phrase means on first impression or on the face of it, before closer examination.

clue.text: One rescued by flying horseman surrounded by African dromedaries

indicators.note: the wanted letters sit enclosed within the two following words

explanation.surface: Someone saved by a rider on a winged horse, among camels in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: Perseus, riding Pegasus in later versions of the myth, saved her from the sea monster.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Ethiopian princess chained to a rock was freed by the hero Perseus.

clue.text: Cutting the roast at first with charm

indicators.note: at first asks for the opening letter of each of the two preceding words

parts.note: to charm is to enchant

explanation.surface: Carving the joint while being delightful company.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting remarks are sharp and incisive, the same sense as a biting, keen comment.

clue.text: More calls from the world and his wife

indicators.note: from tells us the answer is made out of the letters of the two words, rearranged

explanation.surface: Phone calls pouring in from everybody.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'the world and his wife' means everyone, just as all comers means anyone who turns up.

clue.text: Ezra Pound's heart battered and blue

indicators.note: battered means knocked out of shape, so the letters are reshaped
the heart of the poet's surname is its central letter

explanation.surface: The American poet Ezra Pound is left emotionally bruised and depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a heraldic and poetic name for a bright sky-blue colour.

clue.text: Fresh approach covering the ultimate in cookery books

indicators.note: the rearranged letters cover, or enclose, the final letter
fresh means new, so the letters are made anew
the ultimate is the last, so the closing letter of the word

explanation.surface: A new take on the latest in recipe books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fresh' rearranges APPROACH to APOCRPHA, which covers Y.
explanation.definitionFit: The Apocrypha are books of doubtful authority excluded from some versions of the Bible.

clue.text: See 10
What you might need, when at first you spot wasp in apartment

indicators.note: the three initials are placed inside the apartment word

parts.note: a flat is an apartment

indicators.note: at first asks for the opening letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: The tool to grab when you see a wasp indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A swatter for insects is just what you need on finding a wasp indoors.

clue.text: City's to be conquered in the end

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles, plus the possessive S
to fall is to be defeated, as a besieged town does

explanation.surface: A town fated to be overrun when all is done.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as LA'S TO FALL: Los Angeles is due to be conquered.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means finally, after everything else, which matches 'in the end'.

clue.text: Gone ahead, accepting a terrible year with one thing on top of another

definitions.text: with one thing on top of another

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so other letters go inside

parts.note: to have gone ahead is to have led

indicators.note: terrible signals a jumbled version of the next word

explanation.surface: Having pressed on, taking in a dreadful twelve months with piled-up troubles.
explanation.definitionFit: Layered describes things arranged in strata, each level sitting above the next.

clue.text: In the pipeline, the tons of crude oil initially imported by Arab country being curtailed

indicators.note: the initials are brought inside the country's name
curtailed means docked of its tail, so the final letter goes

parts.note: Yemen is a country on the Arabian peninsula

indicators.note: initially asks for the first letter of each of the five preceding words

explanation.surface: A report that crude oil cargoes are on their way into a shrinking Arab state.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures tankers sailing in, but the oil is just one of five words whose initials (TTOCO) are taken; 'being curtailed' leaves YEME, which takes them in.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in the pipeline is planned but has not yet happened, still in the future.

clue.text: In a way that's recurring decimal?

definitions.meaning: describes something done frequently, again and again
decimal means based on the number ten

explanation.definitionFit: Frequently means happening repeatedly, and a decimal system is counted in tens.

clue.text: Sexy amateur role essentially gets praise

indicators.note: essentially means at its essence, so the central letters of each word are taken

explanation.surface: An attractive amateur actor's part wins acclaim.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to praise highly and enthusiastically.

clue.text: Red ground edgy but even

indicators.note: the even-numbered letters of the two words are taken

explanation.surface: Crushed red pigment, rough-textured but uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruddy describes a healthy reddish colour, as in a ruddy complexion.

clue.text: Choose the Guardian's first game in case of brief visits

indicators.note: first puts the card game at the front of the answer

parts.note: whist is a card game
lest means in case, for fear that
to choose is to opt
the setter speaking for the newspaper: ours

explanation.surface: An invitation to pick the paper's favourite game as a precaution.
explanation.definitionFit: A tour made up of many short stops, as politicians campaigning do, from trains pausing briefly at small stations.

clue.text: Gratefully received royalty payments

parts.note: ta is British slang for thank you, said on receiving something
kings are royalty

explanation.surface: Royalty cheques that an author was thankful to get.
explanation.definitionFit: Takings are the money taken in by a business, receipts from payments made to it.

clue.text: Educated and beautiful, finally made some money

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the preceding word

parts.note: to make money from work is to earn it

explanation.surface: Someone clever and good-looking who has also struck it rich.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned person is scholarly and well read, the result of education.
